crossRefs.note: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the…
He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one…
He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…
If anyone comes to you, and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
